summary: Hiker slipped on ice and slid about 200 ft down North Sheep Mountain, suffering head, back, and limb injuries; a friend tied him to a fallen tree with a belt; CCSAR-N completed an 11-hour, 1,600-ft multi-pitch technical night evacuation.
location: North Sheep Mountain near Buena Vista
notes: Below-freezing temperatures ruled out a helicopter rescue; scene cleared 4:41 a.m. Nov 16.
